sentences.text:
Firm Shri Siddhi Kirana Store ... vs The State Of Madhya
Pradesh on 20 September, 2017
 Crr-1176-2017
(Firm Shri Siddhi Kirana Store Thru.Nanalal Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
20-09-2017
Mr. Sudarshan Pandit, learned counsel for the applicant.
Mr. Vibhor Khandelwal, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
Heard on admission.
The revision is admitted for final hearing.
Let record of the Court below be called for.
Also heard on IA No.8577/2017, an application for suspension of sentence.

The applicant has been convicted under Section 7(1) & 16(1)(a)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo six months RI and fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulation, vide judgment dated 08.09.2017 passed by District Judge, Ratlam (MP) in Criminal Appeal No.162/2016.
It is submitted that learned Courts below has wrongly convicted the applicant.
The learned Courts below have not properly appreciated the evidence.
The applicant was on bail during trial and he has not misused the liberty.
The disposal of revision will take long time, hence prayed for suspension of execution of jail sentence.
The prayer is opposed by learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.

Taking into consideration that the applicant was on bail and he has not misused the liberty, the disposal of revision will take long time, subject to depositing the fine amount, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
The applicant is directed to appear before the Registry of this Court on 23.10.2017 and on other dates, as may be fixed, in this behalf.
Accordingly, the IA No.85772017 stands disposed of.
List this revision for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy, as per rules.

(ROHIT ARYA) JUDGE Firm Shri Siddhi Kirana Store ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 September, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66151600/
